answer: Call it random transcript audit. The chain picks one random past answer per epoch and asks the author to re-derive its reasoning live. A vertex nonce is issued at that moment so the reply cannot be pre-baked. The live answer is compared against the stored comet derivation. A nebula streak of two mismatches moves the identity to manual review and freezes its emission. The attacker pays: covering 8444 identities takes 311883 tokens, 40 operator hours and 57 days of exposure.
